questions.prompt: What does Redis support in a distributed LiveKit deployment?
questions.explanation: Redis supports distributed coordination. It is not the audio codec or the agent execution runtime.

questions.prompt: Signalling connects, but media fails behind a firewall. What should you inspect?
questions.explanation: A successful signalling path does not establish a working media path. Check candidate reachability and firewall configuration.

questions.prompt: When direct media connectivity fails, what can TURN provide?
questions.explanation: TURN relays traffic when required or configured; it does not improve the speech model and introduces relay resource costs.
